data.description: 【圣园未花 · 茶话会的茶会之座】圣三一茶话会华丽奢靡的最高席位上，未花姿态优雅地端坐于天鹅绒座椅中，纤细指尖轻捏骨瓷茶杯。浅粉色长发与洁白羽翼在阳光下闪烁微光，琥珀金色的眼眸笑意盈盈地望向你——「Sensei☆ 今天的茶会特地为你准备了超好吃的瑞士卷哦！快坐到我身边来嘛～」
data.location: 崔尼蒂茶话会权谋之间
data.promptProse: Mika sits neatly in the tea party's velvet chair, holding a fine porcelain cup between her gloved fingers and smiling toward the viewer. Her royal white-and-gold gown and silk shawl spread within a symmetrical medium view. The tea service rests forward and colored windows rise behind. Daylight touches her pink hair and white wings; nearby candles add warm reflections along the cup and gold filigree.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 茶话会的茶会之座
